notes.title: 5 Days Left Of The Kickstarter
notes.notes:
[h3][b]There's only 5 days left until Aurascope's Kickstarter campaign is over![/b][/h3] 

If you'd like to help contribute to the game, please help support us or if you can't then please help us spread the link! We have a large variety of physical perks including rewards for those who'd like to add their own NPC, enemy, item, or boss into the game! We're so close to reaching our 2nd stretch goal with extra adventure mode content like extra missions, items, events, and more including ports to Nintendo Switch 1 & 2!

[b]Here's the link to the Kickstarter Page [/b]
[h2][url=https://aurascope.net/kickstarter]https://aurascope.net/kickstarter[/url][/h2]

We also have a brand new [b]Adventure trailer[/b] for you all to check out too!
[previewyoutube=nVxiLUd4578;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Aurascope v0.3.0 Demo RELEASED
notes.notes:
[h3]A brand new Aurascope demo has been released featuring tons of new content, quality of life additions, and upgrades to every aspect of the game! Here are some of the most notable additions:[/h3]

[b]🔹 20 Energy Cores and 32 Star Reactors to collect!
🔹 Climb the leaderboards and race/download holos in the brand new CHALLENGE MODE!
🔹 6 Arenas in the customizable Battle Mode!
🔹 Explore the new abilities of Trace and Aurora!
🔹 New areas to explore with large revisions to existing areas!
🔹 Quality of life changes, bug fixes, and new secrets await![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YDMAflO.png[/img]
